content: Plan: Implementing M6 Layer 2 painted constraints in 4 commit groups: (1) Constraint type system + typed interfaces; (2) Brush UI with click-drag/right-click-erase/esc-cancel/curve-mode; (3) 3-layer validation with overlays + suggestions; (4) Sim integration via setConstraints worker API + constraint overlays on globe.
